reading: Target entropy is 4.779 of a possible 5.545 nats, so the theta posterior is BROAD (theta is far from identified at T=64) -- consistent with the independent recoverability probe. But the ridge KL is 0.740 for every summary from dim 2 to dim 192, i.e. equal to the uniform baseline (0.766 nats): the LINEAR probe learns nothing and therefore CANNOT settle compressibility. A fitted nonlinear state (a short control pilot or the registered screen itself) is required for the R2 gate.
